ressources.pleine: Reserve full ({max}). Build or plant to get the sap flowing again.

boutons.confirmer_nouvelle: Erase this island and start over?

actions.observer_aide: Tap an animal to photograph it, a ripe plant to harvest, or a tile to inspect it.
actions.retirer_aide: Clears the tile and refunds half the cost.
actions.choisi: {action}: tap an island tile. Tap "Observe" to stop.
actions.arroser_aide: Moisture +30 around the tile, held for a day.
actions.mangeoire_aide: Two seeds on the ground draw nearby birds for a day.
actions.tailler_aide: Cuts back a bramble: the meadow opens up again.
actions.effaroucher_aide: The fox stops hunting in this spot for a day.

aides.semer_herbe: A grass tile: the foundation of your meadow and sap supply.
aides.semer_fleurs: Nectar for pollinators, and seeds to harvest.
aides.mare: 2 × 2 water tiles: moistens the surrounding soil.
aides.hotel_insectes: Hollow spaces where wild bees nest.
aides.paillis: Slowly nourishes and cools the soil on one tile.
aides.semer_ronce: Thorny shelter and blackberries in late summer.
aides.planter_bouleau: A pioneer tree: light shade and leaves that feed the soil.
aides.tas_bois: Deadwood: a hedgehog's shelter and winter bed.
aides.nichoir: Place on a mature birch: more room for blackbirds.
aides.agrandir: Adds 2 tiles to the island's radius.
aides.arroser: Tap or drag: moisture +30 around, held for a day (8 sap).
aides.mangeoire: Scatter 2 seeds: blackbirds and skylarks come to peck.
aides.tailler: Tap or drag over brambles: they turn back into grass.
aides.effaroucher: Tap a spot: the fox keeps away and won't hunt there for a day.

refus.arbre_adulte_requis: A nest box needs a mature birch.
refus.rayon_max: The island is at its maximum size for this stage.
refus.absente: This species is no longer here.
refus.pas_de_ronce: There's no bramble to prune here.
refus.pas_de_renard: There's no fox on the island.
refus.recharge: The fox is still wary: try again in {minutes} min.

reussites.photo_premiere: New field journal page: {espece}! +1 page, +10 sap.

carnet.indice_pub_aide: Reveals a hidden need. {nombre} left today.

missions.aucune: No more missions for now. Come back at the next stage!

succession.fin_texte: The Young forest is coming in a future update. Your island keeps living.
succession.teaser_texte: The Young forest is coming in a future update. Meet its conditions now to see what sprouts…
succession.chene: An oak has sprouted under the birches. More is growing…
succession.chene_texte: Your island is ready for the Young forest, coming in a future update. The little oak is waiting for neighbors.
succession.chene_odile: Look under the birches: a little oak has sprouted! The Young forest is beginning.

bonus.explication: The choice is yours. You receive the bonus after the ad.
bonus.pluie_aide: Moisture +30 across the island, right away. Once every 10 minutes.
bonus.prolonger_aide: One more day of {evenement}. Once per event.
bonus.reserve_pleine: Your sap reserve is full: nothing to double for now.

journal.surpaturage: Too many rabbits: a grass tile is grazed bare.
journal.foudre: Lightning felled a birch: deadwood for the forest edge.
journal.rare: Rare specimen: {espece} in {papier}! Take a photo quickly.
journal.depart_hiver: {espece}: no place to hibernate, it left.
journal.depart_demande: {espece}: one left, with no answer to its request.

odile.reserve_pleine: Your sap reserve is overflowing! Build or plant and it will fill up again.
odile.premiere_demande: The residents have requests! The "?" marker on the island says what they need, and the circle how long is left.
odile.depart_hiver: A hedgehog found no log pile for winter. It will come back if the shelter is there.

mesure.aide: Note this down during phone tests.

barre.bientot_aide: {nombre} more builds unlock at the Forest edge.

peinture.aide: Hold and drag to place several.

guide.bienvenue: Welcome! Here you never place animals: you prepare their habitat and they come on their own. Watch the grass…
guide.fleurs_choisir: Flowers feed the pollinators. Tap “Flowers” below.
guide.fleurs_poser: Hold your finger and drag over the golden tiles to sow flowers ({n} / {total}).
guide.hotel_choisir: Bees love your flowers, but they need a nest. Tap “Bug hotel”.
guide.hotel_attendre: The bug hotel costs {cout} sap ({seve} / {cout}). Your plants make sap on their own.
guide.hotel_poser: Place the hotel on a golden tile, near the flowers.
guide.pierres_choisir: Rabbits want grass and a hiding place. Tap “Rock pile”.
guide.pierres_poser: Place the rock pile at the edge of the grass, on a golden tile.
guide.mare_poser: Dig the pond on the golden tiles: the soil all around gets damp.
guide.paillis_poser: Drag over the golden tiles near the pond to spread mulch ({n} / {total}).
guide.jauge: Well done! This gauge shows what your meadow needs to become a forest edge. Tap it.
guide.fin: Your turn! Tap an animal to photograph it: every photo fills your field journal.
guide.recolte: Your flowers made seeds! Tap “Collect”: you need seeds to sow flowers, brambles and birches.
guide.vu_sauterelle: The grasshoppers came on their own: the grass feeds them.
guide.vu_abeille: The bees are here: flowers to visit and a hotel to nest in.
guide.vu_lapin: A rabbit! Grass to nibble and rocks to hide under.
guide.vu_ver: Earthworms: the pond and the mulch made the soil damp and rich.
guide.vu_alouette: The skylark came to eat the grasshoppers, in wide open space.

astuces.bouleau_ombre: This young birch has stopped growing: too much shade. Plant birches at least 2 tiles apart.
astuces.graines: Grown flowers make seeds. You need seeds to sow flowers, brambles and birches.

refus_nichoir: Nest boxes go on a grown birch. The furthest along will be ready in ~{min} min.

carte.semer_fleurs: Near the bug hotel, flowers give twice as many seeds.
carte.tas_pierres: The more grass close by, the more rabbits the pile shelters.
carte.mare: Green where the pond will make the most ground damp enough for earthworms.
carte.hotel_insectes: The more flowers around, the more bees.
carte.paillis: On ground that's already damp, mulch makes a worm corner.
carte.semer_ronce: On the edge of the meadow, not the middle: the skylark keeps its ground.
carte.planter_bouleau: Next to brambles: a real forest edge for the blackbird.
carte.tas_bois: Surrounded by brambles, the pile shelters two hedgehogs for winter.
carte.nichoir: Near brambles, the blackbird can feed its brood.
carte.tailler: Green where brambles eat into the meadow.

limite.ronce_nichoir: limited by brambles and nest boxes

surpaturage.texte: The grass is yellowing around the burrow ({n} tiles): {lapins} rabbits graze faster than it grows back.
surpaturage.odile: The grass is yellowing by the burrow: too many rabbits for so little grass. Sow around it, or move a shelter.

ronces.titre: Brambles are taking over the meadow
ronces.texte: Brambles cover {part}% of the island and are spreading into the grass: the skylark needs open meadow.
ronces.odile: The brambles are creeping into the grass! Prune the ones biting into the meadow, or the skylark will leave.

sec.texte: Some flowers or earthworms are running out of water (moisture {h} here).
sec.odile: The ground is drying out over here. A splash of water, some mulch or a pond, and everyone breathes again.

hiver_herisson.titre: A hedgehog with no winter shelter
hiver_herisson.texte: {herissons} hedgehogs for {places} spot(s) in log piles: {manque} short.
hiver_herisson.odile: Winter is coming and a hedgehog has nowhere to sleep. One more log pile, near the brambles, and it will stay.

renard.titre: The fox is emptying the burrow
renard.texte: Only {lapins} rabbits left: if the fox keeps going, it'll have nothing to hunt and will leave.
renard.odile: The fox is overhunting: hardly any rabbits left. Shoo it away from the burrow for a while.

lapin_abri.tas_pierres: A rock pile a bit further away

merle_nid.titre: The blackbirds are looking for a nest
merle_nid.texte: The blackbirds would like a nest box on a grown birch.
merle_nid.echec: No nest box: a blackbird went to nest elsewhere.

abeille_fleurs.texte: They'd like 3 more flowers around their hotel.
abeille_fleurs.echec: Too few flowers by the hotel: the bee swarm has shrunk by half.

lapin_abri.texte: The burrow is full. A new rock pile, a little further away and in the grass, would take the young ones.
lapin_abri.echec: With no shelter, a rabbit went elsewhere.

merle_faim.texte: In winter there are no worms or berries: a few seeds on the ground would help.
merle_faim.echec: Nothing to peck this winter: a blackbird left the island.

ver_sec.texte: The soil is drying out above the worms (moisture {base}). Water or mulch this spot.
ver_sec.echec: The soil stayed dry: the worms burrowed deeper, only half are left.

vie.rien: All is well for now. Keep watching: the island changes with the seasons.
vie.recompense: In time: pages, sap, young ones and a better chance of a rare specimen.
vie.aide: The ! (problem) and ? (request) markers sit on the island. Tap them to see what to do; the emptying circle shows the time left.
